description_en: Queries the virtual border routers (VBRs) loaded on an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）加载的边界路由器（VBR）
name: DescribeExpressConnectRouterChildInstance

parameters.help_en:
The Express Connect Router (ECR) instance ID.
You can call the DescribeExpressConnectRouter operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关实例ID。
可通过 DescribeExpressConnectRouter API 获取
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The associate ID between the Express Connect Router (ECR) and the VBR
parameters.name: association_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the network instance to query
parameters.name: child_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the network instance. Valid values: VBR: virtual border router instance
parameters.help_zh: 网络实例的类型。取值：VBR：边界路由器实例
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The region of the network instance
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no subsequent query is required.
If a subsequent query is required, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1~2147483647。默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

true: sends a check request without modifying service resources.
false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
